params.body:
## What

The three booklet PDFs, rebuilt on a Mac from the sources in #30 (page 10 with the community photo banner and sticker). These are the files the print order was placed with.

They come in their own pull request because together with the sources they were too large for one request. Merge after or together with #30.

## Checked

- All three: 16 pages, no fonts left (text is outlines), photos visible in Preview.
- `KUBO_Booklet_A5_EN_PRINT.pdf`: A5 plus 3 mm bleed, trim box marks the A5.
- Page 10 rendered from each PDF: photo, text and sticker in place.
params.title: Booklet: rebuilt PDFs with the community banner
